verdict.rationale: Slack docs claim 'unlimited message history... fully searchable' [slack-docs-43] and that anything shared in Slack is searchable [slack-docs-47], but no evidence shows actual admin search UI with sender/channel/date filters, and community reports directly contradict the 'full history' claim, noting messages on free plans are memory-holed after 6 months and it's 'virtually impossible' to preserve/search full history without paying [slack-comm-4][slack-comm-6]. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of search filter syntax (from:, in:, before:/after:), admin-specific search/audit tooling, and confirmation that paid-tier full history search is unrestricted for admins.
